decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed included many camping accessories like tents and towels, but I focused on actual backpacks. Within the consideration set, the ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) stood out for its exceptional value: it is highly rated (4.6), has a massive number of positive reviews (nearly 15,000), and is very affordable at $13.99. While the hydration packs from Gelindo and Mubasel Gear were strong contenders, the ZOMAKE packable daypack offers the most versatility for the price.
